The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the [[Pokémon Chronicles]] series of {{aniseries|PTS}} in {{pmin|the United Kingdom}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 2}}). __TOC__ ==Single volume releases== The Pokémon Chronicles single volumes were released by {{wp|Entertainment One|Contender Entertainment Group}} in 2005 and 2006. The four volumes contain all 22 episodes, merging ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'' into one "feature length episode." Volume 1 is available on DVD and VHS; the other volumes are only available on DVD. Volume 2 is a "Special Bumper Volume" which includes the DVDs for both Volume 2 and Volume 3 in the same case; Volume 3 was not sold separately. Volume 4 is marketed as a "Bumper Edition", containing more episodes than other volumes, and was not included in the box set. "Aerodactyl" is misspelled as "Aerodcactyl" in the title of the episode ''[[HS15|Putting the Air Back in Aerodactyl!]]'' in the DVD menus of Volume 3. ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' (''[[PK02|Christmas Night]]'' and ''[[PK03|Kanga Games]]'') | January 30, 2006 |} ==Box set== [[File:Chronicles Box Cover.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon Chronicles box set]] The Pokémon Chronicles box set was released by {{wp|Entertainment One|Contender Entertainment Group}} on September 5, 2005. The set contains three volumes within a cardboard sleeve, containing 15 episodes across them combined, although the first three episodes are merged into ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'' as a "feature length episode"; it does not contain the whole Pokémon Chronicles series due to lacking Volume 4. Its catalogue number is CTD10356. The discs are identical to those released in the individual volumes. "Aerodactyl" is misspelled as "Aerodcactyl" in the title of the episode ''[[HS15|Putting the Air Back in Aerodactyl!]]'' in the DVD menus of Volume 3.
